description: This file defines the BOMHelper utility class for handling product's bill of materials within the OFBiz manufacturing module. It includes static methods for calculating product depth, detecting duplicate ancestors, and creating production runs for shipments.

classes.name: BOMHelper
classes.description: A final utility class containing static methods for operations related to bills of materials, such as calculating product hierarchy depth, detecting duplicate product ancestors, and generating production runs.

methods.name: getMaxDepth
methods.description: Recursively computes the maximum depth (low level code) of a product within its bill of materials hierarchy based on parent-child associations.

methods.name: searchDuplicatedAncestor
methods.description: Searches for a duplicate ancestor of a product with a given productIdKey to prevent loops when adding components to BOM.

methods.name: createProductionRunsForShipment
methods.description: Creates production run entries for each shipment plan associated with a shipment ID by invoking related services.
